description: Adding the resolvent of two member clauses preserves exactly the satisfying valuations of a finite clause set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.add_resolvent_models.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  {Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.ClauseSet α} {C D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Clause α}
  {p : α} (hC : C ∈ Γ) (hD : D ∈ Γ) (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Models v
      (insert (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.resolvent p C D) Γ) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Models v Γ
